description: Broad curated pantheon of Hungarian historical, political, cultural and scientific figures, alongside international thinkers. Hungarian stories prioritize directly relevant Hungarian figures and the wider Hungarian historical tradition. Legendary, disputed and foreign rulers are explicitly contextualized; do not present tradition as verified biography.
